Home At ... on 4 March, 2025

Author: Manju Rani Chauhan

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:30962
Court No. - 52
Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 6875 of 2025
Applicant :- Anas (Husband) & 6 Others
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Through Secretary Home At Lucknow And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Avnish Kumar Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
Mr. Mohammad Afzal, learned counsel has filed his Vakalatnama on behalf of the opposite party
no.2 today in the Court, which is taken on record.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the charge sheet dated 06.08.2023 and cognizance/summoning order dated 19.09.2023 as well as the entire proceeding of Criminal Case No.22531 of 2023 (State vs. Anas and Others), arising out of Case Crime No.0223 of 2023, under Anas (Husband) & 6 Others vs State Of U.P. Through Secretary Home At ...

sentences.text:
on 4 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82388506/
1 Sections 498A, 323, 354, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act and 3/4 Muslim Women (Protection of Right on Marriage) Act, 2019, Police Station-Lisari Gate, District-Meerut, pending before the court of Special Chief Judicial Magistrate, Meerut on the basis of compromise.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have amicably settled their dispute and a compromise has been entered into between the parties and they are decided to live separately.

entities.text: Muslim Women (Protection of Right on Marriage) Act, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In this regard, a compromise deed on behalf of both the parties has been filed before the court concerned, copy of the same has been appended as Annexure No.4 of this application.

Therefore,
continuance of proceedings against the applicants would futile exercise and wastage of time of the Court and will be abuse of process of law.
Hence, proceedings of the aforesaid case be quashed in the light of law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Gian Singh v. State of Punjab reported in (2012) 10 SCC 303.

entities.text: Gian Singh v. State of Punjab reported in (2012) 10 SCC 303
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned AGA, however, submits that it is the concerned court below, which has to verify the fact as to whether the parties have entered into compromise, hence the applicants may approach the concerned court below and move an application with respect to compromise between the parties,
which will be decided in accordance with law.
In view of the above, both the parties are directed to appear before the court below along with an application for verification of compromise deed as well as a certified copy of this order.

It is expected that the trial court may fix a date for the verification of the compromise and after ensuring the presence of parties, pass an appropriate order with respect to the same in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of two months from today.

While passing the order verifying the compromise, the concerned court shall also record the statement of the parties as to whether all the terms and conditions mentioned in the original compromise deed, so filed, have been fulfilled or not?

The court in that scenario will allow the parties to obtain certified copy of the order verifying the compromise deed and it will be open to the applicants to approach this Court again for quashing of the proceedings.
Till verification of compromise between the parties by the court concerned, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
With the aforesaid directions, this application is finally disposed of.

Order Date :- 4.3.2025 Jitendra/-
